g.text: Six tables from the gold data contract. Dimensions filter the facts: one-to-many, single direction.
Display folders: Context, Beds, Population, Per Capita,
Change vs Prior Year, Share and Rank.
Beds and population are stocks on 1 January: measures take
the latest year in context, never a sum over years.
No Facility → Region relationship: the beds fact already
carries the region, so a second path would be ambiguous.
